verseText: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
meaning: God has done many wonderful things in the past to rescue his people. It is good for us to look back and remember them.

recall.question: What will the writer remember?
choices: The works and wonders of the LORD

meaning.question: Why should we remember God's past works?
choices: They help us trust Him now
We should live only in the past

application.prompt: Think of one Bible story where God rescued His people and let it strengthen your trust today.
